overview_description.description: Metarun is the world's first competitive character-based tactical mobile runner game. Built on the web3, Metarun offers true ownership of the gameplay experience to the players. Collect unique NFT Heroes and compete in the Endless continent of Danvig, which abounds with different biomes.
